_comment: Smithing depth demo: a perk-gated craftable weapon at the forge, its tempering recipe at the grindstone (with the vanilla enchanted-item guard), and two smelter recipes (ore->ingot, plus breaking the weapon back down into materials). Recipe conditions use the SHARED ConditionSpec (function + param + comparison + value + or). Vanilla FormIDs discovered via the CLI find/cobjdiag against Skyrim.esm. SteelSmithing perk=0x0CB40D, IronIngot=0x05ACE4, SteelIngot=0x05ACE5, IronOre=0x071CF3, LeatherStrips=0x0800E4.

recipes._comment: CRAFT at the forge, gated on the SteelSmithing perk so it only shows once you've taken it.

TEMPER at the grindstone (sharpeningWheel): createdObject IS the blade. The TemperIsEnchanted(or:true) guard mirrors vanilla so an enchanted copy can't be improved without Arcane Blacksmith; then HasPerk SteelSmithing. Component = 1 steel ingot.
SMELT iron ore -> iron ingot at the smelter (no conditions), mirroring vanilla RecipeIngotIron.
BREAKDOWN: melt the Forged Blade back into a steel ingot at the smelter. Gated on owning at least one blade so the recipe only shows when you have one to break.
